This world, inspired by the epic tales of Manhwa and Manhua, is now in Beta. Forge your legacy through relentless cultivation, alchemy, and combat.

Your Path to Power Awaits:

💪 Cultivation: Sit in meditation (B) to refine your Qi and break through to new realms of power. The deeper your cultivation, the greater your abilities become.

🧪 Alchemy: Seek out rare herbs across the land, master recipes, and craft powerful pills that boost your stats and provide incredible buffs.

⚒️ Mining & Runes: Mine profound ore to craft and roll powerful runes, granting you an incredible boost to your Qi.

⚔️ Combat: Test your might against formidable mobs to farm precious spirit stones and acquire powerful equipment.

💻 Control Scheme:
M1: Punch/Attack
F: Block
Q: Dash
H: Fly (Unlockable)
B: Cultivate
M: Menu
Z/X/C/V: Skill Slots
CTRL/ALT: Shiftlock
